verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents a Data Exports API that triggers export jobs. Its Records and Workflows APIs can retrieve structured data, and integrations can read underlying contract documents and persist signed agreements to internal systems, so programmatic data extraction is a first-party capability. However, the evidence never states export formats or claims a complete account export, and API access is gated behind a paid add-on. missing for 10: documented open export formats (e.g., CSV/JSON/PDF), evidence of complete all-data export for offboarding, export availability without the API add-on, independent or hands-on corroboration.
